@dogecoin_empire In terms of degree of accent, the person I've met to whom I'd say yours is the closest in intensity (but not in kind) is someone who grew up in Québec with French as her first language.

Pressed for a number, I'd say 2.

@dogecoin_empire much stronger accents compared with what I'm used to hearing than you do. What I notice particularly is that you enunciate vowel sounds more strongly than I'd expect--most people around here replace a lot of vowels by the schwa sound...
